# Actual scope/authored quarter-2 singleton evidence

The one root-admitted authored-key singleton completed with an outer exit of
zero and one selected test passed, 19 skipped. Its one receiving child separately
exited zero with bound verification. This packet preserves that actual result
for independent review. Original recorded process absence has not been probed.
This is no bug-class closure, production repair or PR-readiness claim.

The actual initial tool chunk is `e143cb`, session `35271`; the actual final
completion is `12ec83`, exit zero. Exact original returns and root admission are
copied separately. The selected title is `queued-answer metadata receiving >
checks source followup 'scope' 'authored' quarter 2`, duration 2372 ms; native
total is 2.74 s. This is one authored fixed history, not a generated campaign:
no seed, property selection or generated count is inferred from inherited
campaign prerequisites in the prelaunch record.

Exactly one new raw directory matched the complete canonical history and frozen
source: `h02-progress-71040-04724b7e-0737-4566-bdf4-576d7363ee6b`. The original
prepared directory/history paths, worker-start history/cwd, actual supervisor
target, writer path/identity, receipt transport, seal and verification agree.
The 32-entry prelaunch baseline filtered candidates; neither directory order nor
mtime established identity. Lexical `/var` and `/private/var` paths resolve to
the same original directory and are both preserved.

The trace has 206 contiguous raw receipts and the exact 23 retained receipts.
Every one of the 31 console reach states is 1. `publication-reconstruction.json`
keeps all eight root/downstream callbacks in original order, all four complete
publication cuts, actual acquisition settlements and the full phase inventory.
It does not collapse empty callbacks, duplicate messages or event ordering.

Actual source identity is `9ace9960-1b20-4830-b826-1740a8ccfd9f`; recorded root and
downstream identities are `live-query-1` and `live-query-2`. These come from the
current run's sequence-4 identity receipt and are pairwise distinct. They are
not assumed from allocation order. At initial publication 87 and the positive
provider-held cut 134, root key `metadata-root-4` and downstream key
`metadata-downstream-4` contain row 4/rank 40. The held cut has three pending
provider answers. Reload callbacks 159/160 insert row 3/rank 30 and delete row 4;
the final reload baseline is 161. Each callback's complete current rows and
entries agree with its public cut; downstream selected metadata and
`upstreamEntries` agree with the root's actual metadata.

Followup starts at 162, source application is recorded at 177, and acquisition
12 settles fulfilled at 181. Root callback 182 and downstream callback 183 each
contain exactly one update on retained authored row-3 keys, rank 30 to 35.
Complete `previousValue` equals the preceding reload baseline; complete `value`,
callback reads and final followup publication 185 agree. All four virtual fields
are present on both old and current rows. Downstream selected upstream metadata
is complete in both values. Followup settlement 184 records one root callback,
one downstream callback, both subscriptions ready and no loading subset.
The final raw receipt is normal worker-cleaned 206.

The frozen registration orders root ordinary payload check, downstream ordinary
payload check, then metadata receipt check. After the child outcome, it calls
the outcome judgment and `metadata.finish()`; the caller subsequently calls
`reach.assertReached()`. The selected native pass supports these invocations
under that exact source-order assumption. There is no dedicated runtime
finish/assert receipt, UUID-to-console ordinal receipt, precise runtime
coverage or new parent-checker V8 proof. Child source evaluation alone does
not supply that invocation proof. The additive consistency audit imports only
Python standard library modules and reruns no product code or native checker.

The immutable capture contains 1,948 inner files, three outer files and three
actual tool/admission inputs: 1,954 files, 31,401,025 bytes. Each copy's bytes,
length and SHA-256 matched its untouched original. `raw-manifest.json` retains
every original path. The corrected capture audit completed in actual final
tool chunk `a8c2fc`, exit zero, after initial running chunk `de2cb5`/session
`95822`. The first author audit incorrectly parsed the complete test title with
a greedy regex and stopped before any preservation write (chunk `cf2f2b`). Its
source and failure remain intact; additive v2 anchors the registration filename.
The earlier read-only pretty-print error is recorded in
`author-audit-diagnostics.json`. Neither was a product failure or a retry.

Postchecks matched 589 frozen source members, 511 production mappings, nine named
package maps/2,544 own payloads, four reuse links, Node, both locks, preparation
members and 32 external pins. Python executable identity is recorded separately.
These checks do not prove full transitive host/native/dist equivalence or supply
a new compiler result. Native typechecking and coverage remain disabled; the
separate prior exact-source noEmit evidence retains its original scope.

The supervisor reports child exit zero/no signal, bound verification, no
